property: No real estate declared (house, flat, farm or other land)
detail: In each declaration published so far for his current term as Prime Minister (on appointment, 13 December 2023; as of 31 December 2023; as of 31 December 2024; as of 31 December 2025) Tusk answers 'nie posiadam' (I do not own) for a house, a flat, a farm and other real estate. The declaration form covers both his separate property and property in statutory marital community (wspólność majątkowa).
